name: RecruITIG
title: recruIT FHIR IG
description: FHIR Implementation Guide for the recruIT clinical trial patient recruitment support system.

resource.name: Eligibility assessment derived-from Library
resource.description: A reference to the eligibility-criterion Library resource this assessment was derived from. Observation.derivedFrom does not accept Library as a target type, so this extension carries the reference instead.

resource.name: EligibilityAssessmentIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a per-criterion eligibility Observation's business identifier. Derived from the ResearchSubject identifier and the Library identifier of the eligibility criterion.

resource.name: EligibilityGroupIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for the Group containing references to one or more eligibility criteria Library resources

resource.name: EligibilityLibraryIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a criterion expressed in a Library resource

resource.name: GroupCharacteristic
resource.description: An entity referenced in a characteristic

resource.name: ListBelongsToStudy
resource.description: The ResearchStudy the list manages candidates for

resource.name: ObservationDerivedFromLibrary
resource.description: The Library resource containing the eligibility criterion this Observation was derived from

resource.name: recruIT eligibility assessment
resource.description: A per-criterion eligibility Assessment produced by the query engine, indicating whether a single eligibility criterion is met for a ResearchSubject.

resource.name: recruIT eligibility assessment category
resource.description: A custom, non-standard Observation.category code identifying the per-criterion eligibility Assessments produced by the query eligibility engine..

resource.name: recruIT eligibility assessment result
resource.description: The SNOMED CT qualifier values a per-criterion eligibility assessment's value may be set to, indicating whether the criterion is met, not met, unknown, or indeterminate.

resource.name: RecruitResearchStudy
resource.description: A profile for the ResearchStudy resource used to represent a clinical trial.

resource.name: RecruitResearchStudyExample
resource.description: An example of a recruIT ResearchStudy.

resource.name: ResearchStudyEnrollment
resource.description: The Group resource representing the study enrollment

resource.name: ResearchSubjectIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a recruIT-created ResearchSubject's business identifier

resource.name: Screening list clinical study reference
resource.description: A reference to the clinical study that this screening list contains study candidates for

resource.name: ScreeningList
resource.description: A profile for the List resource used to represent a list of identified study candidates.

resource.name: ScreeningListIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a screening List's business identifier, which is the study's own identifier - used as the conditional-update key for a study's screening List.

resource.name: SupersetSyncedEligibilityLibraryIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a criterion expressed in a Library resource when synced from a Superset instance.

resource.name: Test
resource.description: An example of a screening list.

resource.name: UICreatedEligibilityLibraryIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a criterion expressed in a Library resource created via the UI.

resource.name: UICreatedResearchStudyIdentifierSystem
resource.description: The identifier system for a ResearchStudy resource created via the UI.
